feeds.title: Ben Collins Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Ben Collins, an educator, writer, developer, and founder of The Collins School of Data. I create online courses and write about Google Workspace tools. I focus on data analysis and automation, using Google Sheets and Apps Script. I love building lightweight, data-driven applications for the Google stack: Google Sheets, Google Data Studio, Google Apps Script, Google Docs, Gmail, etc.

feeds.title: Coefficient Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about tips and tricks for spreadsheets, new product features and customer use cases on the coefficient's blog. Coefficient is a no-code solution that allows business teams to work with real-time data directly from their spreadsheets. It helps you to sync google sheets to your company systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, Looker, MySQL, Redshift, Slack and more.
